results.interpretation: NULL RESULT in substance despite the incumbent-relative gates passing mechanically. The challenger's own absence_auc is statistically indistinguishable from chance (pooled 0.5029, 90% CI [0.4830, 0.5235] — includes 0.5); the positive delta (+0.0278) exists only because the incumbent rest/schedule/minutes-trend baseline scores BELOW chance (0.4751) at its preregistered fixed orientation. The registered hypothesis's 'better than chance' clause is REFUTED. At the 1-per-100 alert threshold the challenger detects 4 of 200 absence events (2.0% event recall) with 5.2% row precision against a 4.5% base rate. Promotion was never on the table: quarantined, and ROADMAP W6 requires prospective performance — there is no retrospective correlation here to footnote. This kills the W6 micro-signal v1 cheaply, which is what the quarantine queue is for.
results.method: absence_auc is a set-level rank statistic; per-game paired residuals do not exist for it, so compare_to_incumbent()'s per-game loss contract cannot host the primary metric. Recorded via registry.evaluate() — the harness's documented path for evaluations produced outside compare.py (registry.py docstring). Gates computed here against the preregistered thresholds in compare.py's orientation: delta = challenger_auc - incumbent_auc (higher-better, positive = improvement); CIs from a seeded game-date-clustered percentile bootstrap recomputing AUC per replicate (n_boot=2000, seed=20260730, level 0.90), matching compare.py's primary clustering; team-clustered sensitivity CI alongside.
results.regime_note: Regime B: ground truth = ESPN game-day-final DNP reasons (keyword-classified). No pregame Q/D/P designations, no played-hurt labels, no intraday timestamps (post-game artifacts: time-of-day coverage is nil by construction). Season-long absences (suspension/overseas/pregnancy) are structurally invisible; COACH'S DECISION/REST can mask injuries. Results apply to the covered subset only.

hypothesis: Two-stage conditional minutes model - Stage A L2-logistic P(plays) over the dressed roster and Stage B ridge E[min|played] on played rows, both on shifted walk-forward features (MINUTES_MODEL_SPEC groups A-E) plus point-in-time availability features from the injury-history archive (bbref transaction wire + ESPN missed-game records, strictly-prior-day rule) - beats the B3 shifted-EWMA floor (pooled 4.6428, minutes_ewma_vs_carryforward_v1 run 1) on played-rows minutes MAE walk-forward 2024/2025/2026. features_desc: Adjustment: strength_v(team) = 200 * sum_p w_v(p)*val(p) / sum_p w_v(p); margin_v = str_margin_cal + 0.80 * [(strength_v - strength_1)_home - (strength_v - strength_1)_away] (0.80 = 80 team possessions per game / 100-poss RAPM units, fixed a priori). val(p) = rapm_v0 net_100 (lambda_chosen column); players missing from rapm_v0 -> 25th percentile of net_100 (fixed from the committed artifact). Weights: w_1 = min_ewma (as-of trend minutes, availability-blind); w_2 = p_plays * pred_min_played from minutes_twostage_availability_v1 test predictions (pregame-knowable, regime-B); w_3 = played_flag * Stage-B prediction with started_last := target-game starter_flag (documented approximation: the model was trained on started_last semantics); w_4 = actual minutes. Universe: dressed M2 test rows of the minutes experiment, both teams; per-game coverage counted; a game drops from ALL variants if any team has zero covered rows or missing channel row.
hypothesis: Injecting player-availability information into the promoted structural channel margin forecast via a minutes-weighted RAPM strength adjustment improves margin MAE on the 673 channel-reval test games (2024/2025/2026), and the four-run oracle bracket - (1) no availability / (2) reconstructed regime-B two-stage minutes / (3) pregame oracle = final active-DNP status + confirmed starters / (4) omniscient actual minutes (diagnostic ceiling ONLY, contaminated by in-game information) - brackets how much of the model-vs-bookie MAE gap is lineup information. The GATED claim is only variant 2 vs variant 1 (the deployable system); variants 3-4 are preregistered sensitivity outputs, never promotable.

features_desc: As v1 except the adjustment: m_v(team) = sum_p w_v(p)*val(p) / sum_p w_v(p) (minutes-weighted mean RAPM net_100 over the dressed universe); margin_v = str_margin_cal + LINEUP_SCALE * [(m_v - m_1)_home - (m_v - m_1)_away], LINEUP_SCALE = 4.0 = 5 on-floor slots x (80 team possessions per game / 100), fixed a priori, no fitting. Weights unchanged: w_1 = min_ewma (trend, availability-blind); w_2 = p_plays * pred_min_played (deployable regime-B); w_3 = played_flag * StageB(started_last := actual starter) (pregame oracle, documented approximation); w_4 = actual minutes (omniscient, diagnostic only). val = rapm_v0 net_100, missing -> p25 (-0.890 from the committed artifact). Universe: minutes-model M2 test rows; regular-season channel test games only (the 46 playoff games are outside the minutes system per MINUTES_MODEL_SPEC 2.1 - identical exclusion for all variants).
hypothesis: Identical hypothesis to oracle_availability_bracket_v1 (four-run availability oracle bracket over the promoted structural margin forecast; gated claim = reconstructed regime-B variant vs no-availability; oracle variants preregistered sensitivity, never promotable; omniscient minutes = diagnostic ceiling only). v1's registered adjustment mechanics contained a DIMENSIONAL ERROR discovered in smoke testing BEFORE any ledger evaluation: strength = 200 * weighted-mean-RAPM with a further 0.80 possessions factor overweights the lineup adjustment by ~40x (RAPM is per-100-possessions; the correct game-points scale for a minutes-weighted lineup mean is 5 on-floor slots x 80 team possessions / 100 = 4.0). v1 stays on the ledger as a registration with no evaluation; this registration supersedes it with corrected, dimensionally-checked mechanics.

No new point forecasts; no refitting of the margin model.

features_desc: Committed inputs only: predictions_v2.csv (str_margin_cal), the two odds tables + raw snapshot-derived line paths (extension era 2025-07+ has multi-snapshot paths; old era is single-snapshot and is reported separately, never blended). Matched-time line: latest snapshot at or before each contract cutoff (T-24h primary; T-8h/T-90m where snapshots exist - 2/day backfill era supports T-24h/T-8h only, coverage counted). Flat-stake sim: bet home/away when |model - line| >= threshold grid {0.5,1,1.5,2,3} points at -110 synthetic juice AND at actual captured prices where present (both reported); CLV = line moved toward model side by latest pre-tip; ROI on actual outcomes. Bootstrap CIs clustered by date. Transfer curve: ROI vs edge-threshold vs the margin-MAE delta each threshold implies, using the committed oracle-bracket variant predictions (v1/v2/v3/v4 margins from game_level_margins.csv) as four points of known MAE spacing.
hypothesis: Measurement experiment (no promotion decision): (1) the model-vs-market margin-MAE gap, when measured at MATCHED decision times on the multi-snapshot extension era (model vs the line available at T-24h, not the near-tip line), is materially smaller than the 0.373 headline measured against ~T-64m lines; (2) a flat-stake simulation of betting str_margin_cal edges vs the matched-time line, graded against the latest pre-tip line (CLV) and actual outcomes (ROI), yields an empirical MAE-to-ROI transfer curve that derives what pooled-MAE improvement a break-even betting policy actually requires - replacing the template 0.10 bar with an evidence-derived one.
